intro_html:
These source-dated technology-trend explainers use original diagrams to unpack a specific AI or business-system question. Each carousel links its primary source and states the announcement date and the date it was checked. Start with the six-slide gallery for the visual explanation, then use the source notes to distinguish the announcement from the analysis and its limits.

The slides and downloadable PDF keep the same evidence together. For longer explanations and practical decision tools, explore the writing library and the AI and property, business systems, and technology topic collections. All explainers here are English originals by Ahmadreza Samadi.
